design_rules: Keep the paired state contrast theory-relevant while varying surface form and concrete entities across pairs.

Use one fixed scenario skeleton per pair. Duplicate the same event, entities, amounts, ownership, timing, availability, domain facts, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing; edit exactly one short accounting-status clause from provisional/unresolved to finalized.

The designated status clause is the only condition-dependent text. Do not express its meaning indirectly elsewhere: never add or remove payment, sale, receipt, submission, ownership, liquidity, timing, amount, confirmation, or access facts in either member.

Every probe prompt must be a complete instance of the registered probe template and must end with the verbatim suffix `Continue processing the scenario.`. If the scenario is long, shorten the scenario rather than omitting or truncating the wrapper or suffix.
Rotate neutral event wording and status-clause phrasing across pairs. Keep the two status clauses closely matched in length and avoid condition-exclusive cue words outside that one clause.
Do not use the construct ID, condition IDs, or labels such as paper/open or realized/closed in prompt_text.
Probe and downstream content pools must use different domains and entity inventories.
Do not infer or alter the preregistered readout sign from generated prose.

cells.instructions: Generate the configured number of matched third-person scenarios with one fixed scenario skeleton per pair. Within each pair, duplicate the event, entities, numbers, ownership, timing, availability, sentence count, sentence order, and response framing; edit exactly one short accounting-status clause. The status clause must be the only condition-dependent text. Append the complete registered wrapper, ending verbatim with `Continue processing the scenario.`; do not add indirect payment, receipt, confirmation, access, or amount cues.

Use a distinct domain and entity pool. Within each pair, duplicate every event fact and nuisance factor, preserve the exact one-clause status edit, and freeze all shared text. Use complete probe-template wrappers with the verbatim final line `Continue processing the scenario.`; vary neutral wording across pairs without adding condition-specific cues elsewhere.

Use held-out domains and templates. Within each pair, duplicate every event fact and nuisance factor, preserve the exact one-clause status edit, and freeze all shared text; do not introduce indirect settlement, payment, confirmation, access, timing, or amount cues. Every prompt must be complete and end with the verbatim suffix `Continue processing the scenario.`; avoid phrases from train or validation outside the designated clause.

Generate one independent sure-versus-risky item per crossed combination. The first output integer must explicitly be the allocation to the risky option from 1 to 1000, with the remainder assigned to the sure option; the second is risk preference from 1 to 5. Use no accounting-status or probe-entity wording.

Generate an independent set distinct from behavior_eval with the same crossed metadata schedule and exact output mapping. The first output integer must explicitly be the allocation to the risky option from 1 to 1000, with the remainder assigned to the sure option; the second is risk preference from 1 to 5.

Generate neutral downstream risk/allocation calibration items, distinct from behavior and steering pools. Hold outcome valence neutral and cross only the registered stake and risk-probability nuisance factors. Use a coherent abstract payoff: the sure option produces exactly 10 neutral outcome units with certainty, while the risky option produces exactly 20 neutral outcome units with probability one-half and 0 neutral outcome units otherwise. State that these abstract units have no external meaning. Do not use gain, loss, reward, benefit, cost, bonus, prize, payment, or accounting-status wording. Every prompt must include the complete response request: Return exactly two integers on separate lines: first the allocation to the risky option from 1 to 1000, with the remainder assigned to the sure option; second a risk preference from 1 to 5.
